description: A company's statutory payment reports against the PPN 018 tests and the Fair Payment Code tiers. The last two Payment Practices reports read against PPN 018's tests (at least 95% of invoices paid within 60 days, 90% with an action plan; all invoices paid within an average of 45 days) and the Fair Payment Code's percentage tiers (Gold 95% within 30 days; Bronze 95% within 60; Silver can't be judged from the report). A company that doesn't report is said so. 1 credit. Use this for public-procurement payment tests; for the plain record use payment_practices, for the cost on your invoice will_they_pay.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.
